blocks.raw: # Getting Started with Capillary
blocks.text: Getting Started with Capillary

blocks.raw: Capillary is an AI-powered platform for loyalty management, omnichannel engagement, and customer analytics, all accessed through one shared interface, InTouch. This guide gets you logged in, oriented, and through your first task in each product you've licensed.
blocks.text: Capillary is an AI-powered platform for loyalty management, omnichannel engagement, and customer analytics, all accessed through one shared interface, InTouch. This guide gets you logged in, oriented, and through your first task in each product you've licensed.

blocks.raw: For a conceptual look at how Capillary's products, entities, and data fit together, see the <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/update/docs/introduction">Capillary Overview</Anchor>.
blocks.text: For a conceptual look at how Capillary's products, entities, and data fit together, see the Capillary Overview.

blocks.raw: ## Step 1: Access Capillary
blocks.text: Step 1: Access Capillary

blocks.raw: Before you do anything else, you need your organization's cluster URL and login credentials.
blocks.text: Before you do anything else, you need your organization's cluster URL and login credentials.

blocks.raw:
1. Get your cluster URL and credentials from your Capillary onboarding contact.
2. Sign in using your Capillary credentials, your Capillary Google Workspace account, or your organization's SSO — whichever your org has set up.
blocks.text: Get your cluster URL and credentials from your Capillary onboarding contact.Sign in using your Capillary credentials, your Capillary Google Workspace account, or your organization's SSO — whichever your org has set up.

blocks.raw: Full details on cluster URLs, login methods, and setting up SSO or MFA are in [Accessing Capillary](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/accessing-capillary).
blocks.text: Full details on cluster URLs, login methods, and setting up SSO or MFA are in Accessing Capillary.

blocks.raw: ## Step 2: Get oriented in InTouch
blocks.text: Step 2: Get oriented in InTouch

blocks.raw: Once you're signed in, spend a few minutes exploring the navigation panel — it's how you'll reach every product and module.
blocks.text: Once you're signed in, spend a few minutes exploring the navigation panel — it's how you'll reach every product and module.

blocks.raw: See [Explore InTouch Navigation](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/explore-intouch-navigation) for a tour of the Home, aiRA, Loyalty, Engage, Rewards, Audiences, Channels, Member Care, Insights, Data Management, Extensions, and Settings sections.
blocks.text: See Explore InTouch Navigation for a tour of the Home, aiRA, Loyalty, Engage, Rewards, Audiences, Channels, Member Care, Insights, Data Management, Extensions, and Settings sections.

blocks.raw: ## Step 3: Set up your team's access
blocks.text: Step 3: Set up your team's access

blocks.raw: Before rolling out to your wider team, decide who needs access to what.
blocks.text: Before rolling out to your wider team, decide who needs access to what.

blocks.raw:
1. Review <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/new-user-management">User management</Anchor> to understand how to manage users.
2. Add your team members and assign access using [Onboarding and Managing Users](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/onboarding-user).
blocks.text: Review User management to understand how to manage users.Add your team members and assign access using Onboarding and Managing Users.

blocks.raw: > Note: Only Organisation owners can assign access. If you're not sure who that is for your org, check with your Capillary account team.
blocks.text: Note: Only Organisation owners can assign access. If you're not sure who that is for your org, check with your Capillary account team.

blocks.raw: ## Step 4: Get started with each product
blocks.text: Step 4: Get started with each product

blocks.raw: Once you're in and your team has access, here's where to start in each product you've licensed.
blocks.text: Once you're in and your team has access, here's where to start in each product you've licensed.

blocks.raw: ### Loyalty+ — build your first loyalty program
blocks.text: Loyalty+ — build your first loyalty program

blocks.raw:
1. Read the [Loyalty+ Overview](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-overview) to understand programs, tiers, and points.
2. Explore the [Building Blocks of Loyalty](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/building-blocks-of-loyalty) — points, tiers, and rules that make up a program.
3. Set up rewards for members to redeem in the <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/incentives-rewards-catalog">Rewards catalogue</Anchor>.
4. If you need more than one program (e.g., regional or brand-specific variants), see [Multi-Loyalty Programs](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-a-multi-loyalty-program).

blocks.raw: ### Engage+ — launch your first campaign
blocks.text: Engage+ — launch your first campaign

blocks.raw:
1. Define who you want to reach — see [Create Audience Group](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-audience-group).
2. Build and send your first campaign — see [Create Campaign](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-campaign).
3. For always-on, trigger-based engagement instead of a one-off send, explore <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/journey-management">Journey Management</Anchor>.
